notes.title: Revised the construction system.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this update, I completely redesigned the construction system, removing the bulky walls and floors and developing structures that are more realistic in size.
Implemented a feature to hide based on floors, and now you can directly toggle the display of floors in the top right corner.
Revamped the lighting system to illuminate enclosed rooms entirely, rather than just having a circle of light around the lamps.
Additionally, fixed numerous bugs.
